Name: Demetrius' Fruit Salad
Author: bezajel
Description:
This mod adds a single recipe to the game: Demetrius' fruit salad recipe.

Includes gift tastes & some unique gift dialogues.

Recipe unlocks after Dem's 6 Heart event.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SR1sN7L4/Demetrius-Fruit-Salad-export.png[/img]

[b][size=4]How to install:
[/size][/b]
Unzip the mod and place in your Mods folder.


[b][size=4]Compatibility:
[/size][/b]
[u]Event + Dialogue Mods[/u]
This mod does not edit the 6 heart event, so it is compatible with mods that change the event such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23097]Demetrius' Tomato Aesthetics[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19854]Demetrius on the Spectrum[/url]. No vanilla dialogue keys are changed.

Please also be aware that the dialogue in this mod includes some gendered language about Demetrius. When I have time I'd like to add a config option for gender neutral/femme Demetrius, so let me know if this is something you want/need for your play through and I can prioritise it.

[u]Expanded Crop Mods[/u]
The 'Flexible Recipe' config option (on by default) allows the recipe to use modded crop varieties of the ingredients. [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] is required for this option to function.[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31445]Tomato Ancient Seeds[/url] (recommended) - all tomato varieties from this delightful mod can be used. Additional unique gift dialogue for Demetrius.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] - butternut squash from either mod can be used in place of pumpkin.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url] - wild strawberries from this mod can be used in the recipe.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Combined Crops and Recipes[/url] - all the pumpkin and squash varieties in this mod can be used, as well as the white alpine strawberry, and woolly Kate tomato. Litchi tomato [u]can not[/u] be subbed for tomato - it's not actually a tomato.

Any other modded crops using the tomato_item, strawberry_item, pumpkin_item, butternut_squash_item, or winter_squash_item context tags will also be accepted.

Unfortunately, Abigail's unique gift dialogue is removed if Flexible Recipes are enabled. If you have FOMO, check the spoiler.
[spoiler][img]https://i.postimg.cc/jqNKXy2c/Abigail-reaction.png[/img][/spoiler]


[b][size=4]Mod origin story:
[/size][/b]
I'm growing tomatoes this year (IRL). I was eating some cherry tomatoes and I thought 'if someone gave me a fruit salad with tomatoes in it, I wouldn't even be mad'. And thus I realised that this mod needed to be made.

Love botanical classification? Check out this beautiful infographic (by Mark Belan, [url=https://www.artscistudios.com]artscistudios[/url]) I found while researching fruit facts:
[spoiler][img]https://i.redd.it/sqx0kmv2bf061.png[/img][/spoiler]


[size=4]Languages[/size]
i18n enabled. Message me if you would like a translation included.

English (default)
Spanish (included) - gracias a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Eli0630]Eli0630[/url] for the 1.0.0 translation. I did the new 1.1.0 keys myself.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SR1sN7L4/Demetrius-Fruit-Salad-export.png[/img]

Enjoy!
